slides.title: TB-500: a recovery peptide?
slides.text: What's actually known about this popular 'research' peptide 👉

slides.title: A thymosin beta-4 fragment
slides.text: Sold as a peptide said to help tendons and tissue heal. Not FDA-approved for any use in people.

slides.title: On the FDA's safety-concern list
slides.text: In late 2023 the FDA placed TB-500 among 17 'Category 2' peptides — substances of safety concern. An advisory committee was set to review it again in July 2026.

slides.title: Almost entirely animals and cell dishes
slides.text: A 2024 study found TB-500 itself (Ac-LKKTETQ) didn't speed up healing — only its metabolite did. No controlled human trials exist.
